Entry.JapaneseText: はぁ～、きんにいらねぇだ！ おんもしろくねぇだ！ このピリピリした空気感、おらの出番がねーだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Haaah... This's no good! It's uninterestin'! The vibe's all tense, and there's no chance for me to shine!

Entry.JapaneseText: そりゃ、緊張感も大事だぁ。 んだども、ここまで張り詰めてたら気が重いっつーの
Entry.EnglishText: Well, bein' on edge a little, here and there, ain't so bad, either. But, ya know, overdo it and it starts weighin' on ya.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふくろだぬきぐらい能天気なら楽チンだが、 おらはナイーブな方だで、空気が読める男だよ
Entry.EnglishText: That dumb tanuki can be as carefree as he likes, but even straightforward as I am, I'm a man who can read the room.

Entry.JapaneseText: そったらこっで、このまま<Mel><Mel>のポケットで 大人しくしてるのが一番だぁ
Entry.EnglishText: And things bein' as they are, it's best I stay hidin' in <Mel><Mel>'s pocket.

Entry.JapaneseText: ま、まさか、おらの出番はここまでで、 もう日の光を浴びられないなんてことに……
Entry.EnglishText: But... D-Don't tell me... I won't be appearin' again? Never again 'll I see the light of day?

Entry.JapaneseText: んーなバカな話、あるわけねぇ！ おらが出ないっつーことは、芋のないカレーと同じだ
Entry.EnglishText: Well, that's just dumb! A story without me's like a curry without potatoes!

Entry.Notes: will need to see in context
